name: validate
summary: Validate one starter note deterministically before pipeline processing.
description: Reference app capability for the traverse-starter multi-capability pipeline showcase (spec 058-workflow-pipeline-execution). Genuinely reads the `note` input and reports a deterministic verdict: an empty or whitespace-only note yields valid=false with a non-empty issues list, and a note longer than 2000 characters is reported as an issue -- exactly the two rules the prior 1.0.1 fixture's own description claimed but did not implement. No model, network, randomness, or host state dependency. Built no_std on the shared agents/wasi-agent-runtime/ shim: verified to import only wasi_snapshot_preview1::{fd_read, fd_write, proc_exit}, so it is genuinely executable by Traverse's runtime, not just a generic wasmtime host. Source: agents/traverse-starter-validate/ in this repo.

preconditions.description: The caller provides a note string field; emptiness is reported as a validation issue rather than an execution error.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a validation verdict genuinely derived from the provided note -- distinct inputs (empty, whitespace-only, overlong, or normal) produce distinct outputs, deterministically.

side_effects.description: Produces a deterministic validation verdict from the provided input.
